articles.title: Gold edges higher on softer oil; US midterm elections in focus
articles.desc: Following a previous surge, gold prices experienced a minor uptick, influenced by declining oil rates and ongoing inflation concerns. Investors are honing in on the forthcoming US midterm elections for cues on economic direction. Financial analysts speculate a potential interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve in December to combat inflation, while the Bank of England is anticipated to tackle similar issues this Thursday.

articles.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
articles.desc: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

articles.title: Marico profit jumps 31%, flags rising input costs amid West Asia woes
articles.desc: Marico has reported a 13% increase in consolidated revenue, driven by strong volume growth in India and international markets. The company highlighted challenges from rising input costs due to geopolitical tensions and adverse weather circumstances. Managing director Saugata Gupta expressed awareness of potential inflation effects, especially in rural areas. Marico aims for mid-20% EBITDA growth by FY27 and expects annual revenue to exceed ₹15,000 crore.

articles.title: Oil rises after report of US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island
articles.desc: Oil prices have surged in reaction to reports of a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, sparking fears of significant supply interruptions. Previous drops in prices on Monday have been overshadowed by this escalation, reinstating a risk premium in the market. Diplomatic negotiations between Iran and the US, facilitated by Qatar, ended without notable advancement, while looming midterm elections exacerbate tensions in the Middle East, affecting global oil costs.

articles.title: ITC Q2 net profit falls 20% as high taxes keep margins in check
articles.desc: ITC reported a 20% decline in standalone net profit for the September quarter despite a 45% increase in revenue. The rise in cigarette taxation significantly impacted profitability, forcing ITC to absorb part of the price hikes. Non-cigarette businesses showed strong growth, achieving the highest revenue growth in 14 quarters. Factors such as inflation and geopolitical tensions continue to affect the operating environment.

articles.title: Sensex surges over 1,200 points, Nifty reclaims 23,400 as RIL leads rally
articles.desc: Indian equity markets experienced a significant surge, primarily driven by Reliance Industries which saw an 11.6% increase. Easing crude oil prices and renewed diplomatic talks regarding Iran contributed positively to investor sentiment. The BSE Sensex rose by more than 1,200 points, while the NSE Nifty exceeded the 23,400 mark. Broader market segments, including metals and cement stocks, also experienced noteworthy gains.

articles.title: Sebi allows REITs, InvITs to tap overseas investors through depository receipts
articles.desc: Sebi has established frameworks allowing real estate investment trusts and infrastructure investment trusts to issue foreign currency denominated depository receipts. This initiative enables them to access capital from overseas markets through international exchanges in GIFT City. To issue depository receipts, unitholder approval will be required, with a majority supporting such moves. Certain restrictions and conditions will apply to participating trusts and existing unitholders.

articles.title: Jubilant Pharmova plans to raise Rs 800 crore via maiden bond issue
articles.desc: Jubilant Pharmova has announced plans to secure ₹800 crore via its first bond issuance within the local market, featuring ₹400 crore as the base amount and an equal greenshoe option. The capital raised will be primarily allocated to the company’s capital expenditure and upcoming expansion efforts. Subscriptions are anticipated chiefly from mutual funds and asset managers, making this a significant moment in the company's bond market debut.

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks slide as US chip selloff deepens
articles.desc: The MSCI Asia Pacific gauge dropped 0.4% with South Korea’s Kospi Index sliding almost 3%. In the US, a gauge of chipmakers extended a three-day rout to 12% and the Nasdaq 100 sank 10% from its peak, entering a technical correction. In a sign some investors are looking to buy on dips, US stock futures gained. Japan is closed for a holiday.

articles.title: Bank CD rates surge above 8% amid liquidity squeeze, rising T-Bill yields
articles.desc: Public-sector banks have recently increased one-year certificate of deposit rates beyond 8%, influenced by stricter liquidity and high treasury-bill yields. The reduction in banking liquidity has led to a noticeable rise in CD issuances lately. Observers predict further policy rate hikes to address inflation effectively, signaling that the current rates may not yet reflect their maximum potential amidst ongoing market fluctuations.

articles.title: 10-year bond yield eases 10 bps to 7.31% in sharpest fall since April
articles.desc: The 10-year bond yield experienced a notable decline to 7.31% following a decrease in oil prices. This decline represented the steepest drop observed since early April of this year. Oil prices fell nearly 5%, retreating from a six-month peak that occurred last week. Traders are currently holding back on taking fresh positions as they await the US midterm elections.

articles.title: Stocks in news: ITC, Marico, SBI, Yatra Online, NSE, Container Corp and Sun Pharma
articles.desc: Indian equity benchmarks experienced gains, with Nifty nearing the 23,500 resistance level and strong corporate earnings reported. ITC faced a decline in consolidated net profit, impacted by the cigarette business, despite revenue growth. Marico saw a significant rise in net profit and expanding EBITDA margins during the quarter. Container Corporation of India reported a subdued performance with a slight decline in net profit compared to last year.

articles.title: D-Street poised for positive start as GIFT Nifty signals gains
articles.desc: Indian equity markets enjoyed a rally, spurred by robust buying in major stocks such as Reliance Industries. Analysts pegged immediate support for Nifty at 23,200, with resistance encountered at 23,500 and 23,700. Foreign portfolio investors were active buyers, netting Rs 3,115 crore, while domestic institutional investors offloaded shares worth Rs 392 crore. Meanwhile, the rupee dipped by 10 paise to close at 94.

articles.title: We will consider the call for review of LTCG tax: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman
articles.desc: "The circumstances have changed and, therefore, the voices of concern are louder,'' she said at a media event, in reference to reports that her administration has received suggestions to review levies on long-term capital gains (LTCG) for overseas investors. "I quite appreciate that. So, I'll consider all this... Our growth is very important, where people are putting their very best, we are able to see sustained 7(%)-plus growth.''

articles.title: RIL shares surge 11.6% on strong Q2 earnings; analysts see further upside
articles.desc: Reliance Industries has seen an impressive 11.6% surge in stock price, following quarterly earnings that exceeded expectations. This remarkable rise represents the company's most significant increase in over six years. Analysts are optimistic about future growth, crediting this success to strong performance in the O2C sector and increased institutional buying. Brokerage firms predict potential earnings upgrades will further boost stock valuation.

articles.title: FPI holding hits multi-year lows in 70% of top 100 Indian companies
articles.desc: Foreign investors have significantly reduced their holdings in nearly 70% of India's leading companies in recent years. Major firms, including banks and IT sectors, are seeing foreign ownership decline to multi-decade lows. This decrease in foreign investments mirrors diminished expectations for growth in India relative to other global markets. Although some companies experience slight increases in foreign ownership, they still remain at historical lows.

articles.title: Rupee ends flat at 94.90 despite fall in oil prices
articles.desc: The Indian rupee closed at 94.90, witnessing a range from 95.03 to 94.69. Market participants remained on edge with the US midterm elections looming, impacting overall sentiment. Despite falling oil prices and a weaker dollar, there was an uptick in dollar demand. Notably, Foreign Portfolio Investors turned net buyers, purchasing ₹3,114 crore, lending slight support to the rupee.

articles.title: PM plans debt re-set for Commonwealth nations as slavery apology talks begin
articles.desc: The move comes as the prime minister begins talks about the UK issuing a formal apology for the slave trade in the next year.

articles.title: Dip in gold price puts the sparkle back into festive and wedding buying, jewellers see 10-12% rise in Dhanteras sales
articles.desc: Gold prices have dropped significantly, encouraging consumers to return to jewellery stores for upcoming purchases. The correction in gold prices has led to increased footfalls and advance bookings for weddings. Jewellers expect a rise in sales volume on Dhanteras, which is an auspicious buying day. Consumers are opting for lightweight jewellery and lower-karat gold to manage budget constraints.

articles.title: Apple set an iPhone sales record even without a new standard iPhone
articles.desc: Apple had a record-breaking quarter for iPhone sales - despite not releasing a standard model during its latest refresh. The increase in revenue follows the launch of Apple's […]

articles.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq ends over 1% lower as AI worries persist
articles.desc: US stocks ended mixed on Monday, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq closing lower as Apple shares slipped ahead of earnings and Oracle fell over plans to raise $20 billion. Falling oil prices amid US-Iran peace hopes offered some relief, while concerns over Big Tech's AI spending persisted.

articles.title: Meta will end Quest 2 OS updates in 2027
articles.desc: Meta is planning to release the last OS update for its Quest 2 and Quest Pro VR headsets by March 2027, the company announced today. articles.desc: South Africa to lose duty-free access, affecting $1.7bn worth of annual exports, including cars and farm products.

articles.title: El Nino could add to US inflation pressures in 2027, San Francisco Fed paper warns
articles.desc: A San Francisco Fed study warns the current strong El Niño could drive US inflation up by 1 percentage point in 2027, despite temporarily boosting jobs. With inflation already above the 2% target, the climate shock adds further pressure on the Fed to raise interest rates.

articles.title: Irdai tightens ESOP norms, share transfer rules for insurers
articles.desc: Irdai has implemented stricter rules regarding employee stock option plans for insurance companies to regulate ownership stakes. Senior executives and directors must seek approval to exceed prescribed shareholding limits under these plans. Insurers are required to monitor direct and indirect share allotments to prevent regulatory breaches.

articles.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
articles.desc: The move comes barely a week after Rwanda's defence ministry was hit with sanctions by the US Treasury.

articles.title: Govt consults seed, fertiliser firms on easing regulatory hurdles
articles.desc: The Indian government is engaging with agricultural companies to address regulatory challenges that affect the sector. Consultations focus on updating the Seeds Act, 1966, to align with modern agricultural technology. Industry representatives have pointed out delays in approvals and licensing processes that hinder market access.

articles.title: Aditya Birla Lifestyle bets on festive demand
articles.desc: The company, which owns brands such as Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Allen Solly and Peter England, reported flat like-for-like sales growth in September, against 5.3% for the second quarter of FY27. The slowdown comes just as the full impact of price increases begins to flow through in the December quarter, making consumer acceptance and discounting critical to sustaining growth.

articles.title: Manufacturing activity eases in Oct as new order growth drops
articles.desc: Manufacturing activity in India experienced a slowdown in October, decreasing from the previous month's growth. Despite this, the sector remained above its long-run average due to stronger international demand. A survey indicated that nearly 18% of manufacturers anticipated increased output over the next year, supported by fresh client inquiries.

articles.title: Budget 2027: Customs duty relief on 118 goods under review
articles.desc: The Indian government is currently reviewing customs duty concessions applicable to 118 products set to expire. This review involves input from respective line ministries and industry stakeholders regarding these exemptions. Goods under review include materials for power projects and certain medical devices. A focus is on correcting the inverted duty structure to support local manufacturing initiatives. The outcomes of this review will influence the upcoming budget for 2027-28.

articles.title: US manufacturing strengthens in October, input prices stay high
articles.desc: US manufacturing activity accelerated in October, with the ISM manufacturing PMI rising to 55.5 from 54.5 in September, beating Reuters-polled economists' expectations. Strong consumer and AI-related business spending supported growth, but factory input prices remained elevated at 75.2, reinforcing concerns that US inflation could stay above the Federal Reserve's 2% target.

articles.title: VB-G RAM G grievance redressal rules set 15-day deadline
articles.desc: The rules establish a multi-tier grievance redressal mechanism at the gram panchayat, block and district levels. Designated grievance redressal officers will be responsible for receiving, registering, inquiring into and disposing of complaints. Inquiries must be completed within seven working days.

articles.title: Meta eyes at least $20 billion from potential bond offerings, Bloomberg News reports
articles.desc: Meta is reportedly looking to raise at least $20 billion through a cross-border bond offering to fund its expanding AI infrastructure. The potential debt sale follows its planned $97.5 billion equity fundraising, highlighting how major technology companies are increasingly tapping debt and equity markets to finance their artificial intelligence ambitions.

articles.title: Institutional investors step up bets on private credit as insurers, pension funds and DFIs back new funds
articles.desc: Institutional investors are now allocating more funds to private credit, significantly from insurance companies and pension funds. Neo Alternative Asset Managers has seen its second fund receive 22-25% contributions from these investors. Ascertis Credit's fourth fund also attracted commitments exceeding $700 million from multiple institutional investors. With increased interest in private credit, annual investment opportunities are now estimated around ₹1 lakh crore.

articles.title: Anthropic revenue jumps 1,100% ahead of IPO as AI spending commitments near $900 billion
articles.desc: Anthropic reported a 1,100% surge in third quarter revenue to $17 billion ahead of its planned IPO later this month. However, the AI company also disclosed a $23.3 billion net loss and nearly $895 billion in spending commitments, raising questions about AI infrastructure costs and investor appetite for its proposed listing.

articles.title: A month after RBI’s rate hike, banks start raising deposit rates as liquidity shrinks, Bank of India the latest to move
articles.desc: Domestic banks are beginning to increase their deposit rates due to shrinking liquidity conditions in the market. Bank of India recently announced a rate hike on deposits for various maturities, including a special 500-day option. This decision reflects the growing cost of deposits in the banking system as demand for credit rises. Banking system liquidity has significantly decreased from its peak in early September.

articles.title: Trump signals progress on Iran deal as Tehran pushes faster ceasefire
articles.desc: Iran says its offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz can be implemented in two days if the US agrees to terms.

articles.title: Govt set to tweak MSP norms for periodic price hikes of minor forest products
articles.desc: The Centre is planning to restructure the minimum support price mechanism for minor forest produce. This change aims to provide periodic hikes to benefit tribal communities relying on forest produce. TERI has been tasked to study the current MSP framework and assess potential rationalization. Concerns regarding stagnant MSP rates sparking exploitation among forest-dependent communities have been raised in parliamentary discussions.

articles.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas

The announcement comes as opposition to […]

articles.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
articles.desc: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

articles.title: Centre's FY27 fiscal deficit may exceed Budget target by Rs 1.2 lakh crore: SBI Research
articles.desc: India's central government anticipates a fiscal deficit exceeding budget estimates by Rs 1.2 lakh crore in 2026-27. This increase is primarily attributed to rising fertiliser, LPG, and petroleum subsidy expenses. Strong GST growth and disinvestment receipts may not offset the expected higher deficit. In addition, SBI Research recommends a revised long-term capital gains structure to generate additional revenue.

articles.title: Market Trading Guide: Tata Steel among 5 stocks to buy on Tuesday for healthy returns
articles.desc: Indian equities experienced a strong start to the week, bolstered by better than expected Q2 earnings. Improved domestic macro indicators contributed to the positive sentiment among investors and traders. Increased passenger vehicle sales and gross GST collections reflected resilience in domestic economic activity. Several stock recommendations were highlighted for Tuesday, suggesting potential upward movements. Analysts shared technical insights indicating opportunities for buying various stocks in the current market.

articles.title: Oracle plans to raise $20 billion through bonds and stock sales
articles.desc: Oracle has announced its ambitious plan to generate $20 billion through bond and share sales, focusing on both corporate needs and essential infrastructure development. The raised funds are earmarked for advancing initiatives in AI and cloud computing, projecting substantial growth soon. This fundraising will also assist with capital expenses, debt repayment, acquisitions, and share buybacks. Despite a 3.

articles.title: Marvell to buy Lumentum in $115 billion deal in AI data-center bet
articles.desc: Marvell Technology is poised to acquire Lumentum in a groundbreaking all-stock transaction worth $115 billion. This strategic acquisition is intended to position Marvell more competitively against Broadcom in the rapidly growing AI sector. With this expansion, Marvell anticipates boosting its optical components production to satisfy the escalating demand in data transfer spurred by AI innovations in data centers.

articles.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
articles.desc: Indian stock markets surged nearly 2% on November 2, with Sensex gaining 1,233 points and Nifty rising 388 points. Falling crude oil prices, strong corporate earnings, positive global cues and foreign investor buying boosted sentiment.

articles.title: EAAA India draws HDFC MF, Carnelian Asset, and L&T in Rs 316 crore listing-day bulk deals
articles.desc: EAAA India Alternatives attracted Rs 316.3 crore in listing-day bulk deals from HDFC Mutual Fund, Carnelian Asset Management and L&T. The stock listed at a marginal premium before gaining 3.8% over its IPO price.

articles.title: Why traders are moving away from equity F&O to commodities? Nithin Kamath explains
articles.desc: Commodity derivatives traders in India surged nearly 62% to 21 lakh in FY26, while equity F&O participants fell 20% to 85 lakh. Zerodha's Nithin Kamath cited commodity volatility, options popularity and extended MCX trading hours.

articles.title: IPO-bound StockGro's profit jumps 3-fold to Rs 113 cr in FY26 on strong revenue growth
articles.desc: In FY26, StockGro showcased substantial growth, achieving a profit after tax of Rs 112.96 crore while nearly doubling its revenue to Rs 226.14 crore, largely propelled by rising subscription fees. Operational costs increased, leading to higher total expenses. As the company gears up for an IPO, preliminary papers have been submitted to Sebi, with StockGro currently serving over 35 million users and capitalizing on India’s booming retail investment market.

articles.title: Sebi cuts cooling-off period for OFS by privately listed illiquid InvITs to 8 weeks
articles.desc: Sebi has announced a reduction in the cooling-off period for illiquid private listed InvITs. The previous cooling-off period was set at 12 weeks, which has now been changed to 8 weeks. This decision comes in response to feedback from market participants and aims to enhance the ease of doing business. Illiquid InvITs typically face challenges due to low trading volumes and large lot sizes.

articles.title: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty promoters to sell 2.38 cr shares via OFS
articles.desc: In a significant move to adhere to Sebi's minimum public shareholding regulations, Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd announced that promoter Anand Kamalnayan Pandit plans to sell 2.38 crore shares. This transaction is scheduled for November 3-4, with the shares priced at Rs 240 each, despite the company's current share price of Rs 245.90. Presently, promoters own 79.87 percent of the company.

articles.title: Sebi issues rules for depositary receipts on REITs, InvITs units
articles.desc: India's market regulator has unveiled a new framework enabling foreign investors to invest in REITs and InvITs, aiming to boost foreign capital in these sectors. To issue depositary receipts, REITs and InvITs must gain approvals from both local and international exchanges, requiring a minimum of 75% consent from unitholders for any fresh offerings. Currently, established REITs and InvITs in India are already open to foreign investments under certain regulations.

articles.title: Pakistan suffered $40 billion in economic losses due to suspension of trade with India: PIBC chief
articles.desc: Lahore has faced an estimated USD 40 billion in economic losses since trade with India paused in 2019. Business leaders emphasize the need for restoring these commercial ties to stimulate mutual benefits. The suspension has escalated costs for essential goods that are typically imported from India. Industries, particularly textiles and pharmaceuticals, have struggled to cope with rising transportation and sourcing expenses.

articles.title: Fusion Finance swings to Rs 86.5 crore profit as asset quality improves
articles.desc: Fusion Finance reported a net profit of Rs 86.5 crore in Q2, reversing a year-ago loss of Rs 22.1 crore. Gross NPAs improved to 1.6%, AUM grew 14%, and NIM expanded to 12.5%.

articles.title: US stocks today: US stocks rise as oil tumbles on peace hopes, investors eye midterm election
articles.desc: US stocks opened higher on Monday as technology and AI related shares stabilised following October's selloff. Wall Street also drew support from a sharp decline in crude oil prices amid hopes of a US Iran peace deal. The Dow Jones, S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite all advanced at the opening bell.

articles.title: High-yield US stocks: 10 companies offering dividend yields of up to 16.65%
articles.desc: Ten US-listed companies with market capitalisations above $5 billion offer dividend yields ranging from 7.16% to 16.65%. AGNC Investment and Annaly lead, while Western Midstream, MPLX and Main Street Capital delivered positive five-year share-price returns.

articles.title: Capex key to India's growth strategy, fiscal prudence remains...: FM Sitharaman at HSBC event
ITC Q2 Results: Profit falls 18% to Rs 4,229 crore, revenue rises 5%
articles.desc: ITC Q2 Results: ITC Ltd reported an 18.5% decline in consolidated net profit for the September quarter on Monday as a sharp fall in earnings from its cigarette business weighed on overall profitability despite strong growth in its FMCG, agriculture and paper businesses.

articles.title: STT Global’s India biz on the block; micro occasions power qcomm
articles.desc: KKR, Singtel, and the Tatas are preparing to sell STT GDC India, a major data centre platform. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

articles.title: Coforge among 4 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 15% in a month
articles.desc: Four BSE 100 stocks, Coforge, Eternal, Indian Hotels Company and Kotak Mahindra Bank, touched fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex surged over 1,200 points. All four stocks also delivered positive returns over the past month.

articles.title: US Stock Market Highlights: US stocks rise as oil tumbles on Iran peace hopes, investors eye midterm elections
Oil slide hands India's 10-year bond its best day since early April
articles.desc: The recent drop in Brent crude prices is creating an uptick in demand for Indian government bonds, particularly shining on the 10-year note which has experienced its strongest performance since April. As yields decrease, investors are keen to secure these advantageous rates ahead of the US midterm elections, aware of their potential market implications.

articles.title: US stock futures rise as AI stocks catch their breath; midterms in focus
articles.desc: In the US, stock futures surged as investors prepare for the upcoming midterm elections and await earnings announcements. Major tech players, such as Alphabet and SpaceX, enjoyed premarket boosts. Estee Lauder's optimistic sales and profit outlook added to market enthusiasm. However, caution prevails as investors weigh the potential consequences of congressional control post-elections. Additionally, falling oil prices eased worries over supply issues in the Middle East.

articles.title: Market wrap:  RIL, Tata Steel, Infosys, ICICI Bank top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Monday
articles.desc: Indian markets rallied sharply, with Sensex gaining 1.66% to 75,693 and Nifty rising 1.68% to 23,441. Strong quarterly earnings lifted investor sentiment, led by Reliance Industries, metals and oil and gas stocks, while market breadth remained positive.

articles.title: India's economic pillars show 'no fragility', says Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman
articles.desc: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the government's commitment to increasing capital expenditure to promote economic growth. She remarked on the importance of fiscal prudence while implementing spending strategies effectively. Sitharaman emphasized the need for public investment to enhance welfare programs and improve access to essential services. The government aims to provide comprehensive insurance coverage by 2047 to foster financial inclusion.

articles.title: Capex key to India's growth strategy, fiscal prudence remains top priority: Sitharaman at HSBC event
articles.desc: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the importance of capital expenditure in driving economic growth in India. She stated that government spending would be guided by fiscal discipline while encouraging private sector investment. Sitharaman noted that higher public investment has historically generated strong economic returns over time. She reassured that the Indian economy remains robust, with no sign of fragility.

articles.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
articles.desc: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.

articles.title: Diwali cheer! Mukesh Ambani gets $8.5 billion richer in a day as RIL shares soar
articles.desc: Mukesh Ambani experienced a significant increase in wealth following a rally in Reliance Industries shares. The company's stock rose by 11.64%, marking its strongest gain in over six years. Reliance's quarterly earnings surpassed expectations, especially in its oil-to-chemicals and telecom sectors. Analysts have since shown increased optimism about the company's financial outlook and growth prospects. However, challenges remain for Reliance's retail business and overall stock recovery.

articles.title: Marico Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 31% YoY to Rs 550 crore, revenue rises 12%
articles.desc: Marico reported a 31% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 550 crore, while revenue grew 12% to Rs 3,897 crore. EBITDA increased 27%, margins expanded to 18.2%, and management expects double-digit growth during FY27.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds steady near $78,000 as investors assess Binance security breach. Here is what experts say
articles.desc: Bitcoin traded near $78,000 as investors assessed the reported $6.3 billion Binance security breach. Crypto markets showed a modest recovery, while ETF outflows, liquidations, macroeconomic uncertainty and upcoming US events kept investor sentiment cautious.

articles.title: Indians turn to side hustles, freelancing as non-salary income rises: ClearTax
articles.desc: Indians are increasingly earning from non-salary sources like trading and freelancing as reported by ClearTax. The percentage of self-filers reporting such income grew significantly from previous years. Data shows that young individuals are entering investment opportunities earlier than ever before. Additionally, women's participation in capital gains and higher income brackets has increased noticeably. This reflects a significant change in financial habits and diversification of income sources among taxpayers.

articles.title: SBI Q2 Results Preview: PAT may rise up to 25% YoY; NII, margins, deposit growth in focus
articles.desc: State Bank of India will announce Q2FY27 results on November 3, with brokerages forecasting 11-13% NII growth and up to 25.2% profit growth. Investors will track margins, loan growth, deposits, credit costs and asset quality.

articles.title: Ashish Kacholia-owned Knowledge Marine shares jump 4% on Rs 303 crore order win; stock up 67% in 2026
articles.desc: Knowledge Marine shares gained 4.17% after securing a Rs 303.17 crore, three-year maintenance dredging contract from New Mangalore Port Authority. The company also announced a November 6 record date for its five-for-one stock split.

articles.title: Keralam aims to bring in special Act to protect women from social media attacks
articles.desc: "The government is thinking of sending those who attack women on social media to prison by bringing in a special Act," CM V D Satheesan said while inaugurating 'Makalkoppam', a two-day seminar organised by the Women and Child Development Department to formulate a women's policy after discussions with various stakeholders.

articles.title: India’s manufacturing output dominated by large factories, while smaller units lag behind
articles.desc: India's manufacturing sector is highly fragmented, with large factories significantly outpacing small units in productivity and output. While large establishments employ most industrial workers and generate high GVA, smaller units remain burdened with debt. The productivity gap is exacerbated by limited access to technology and training for smaller factories. Additionally, women workers constitute a small fraction of the overall workforce in manufacturing.

articles.title: How are equity investments taxed in India? A guide to capital gains tax
articles.desc: In a bid to invigorate domestic and foreign mutual fund investments, India's Securities and Exchange Board has put forth recommendations for tax concessions. These proposals are designed to boost post-tax returns, particularly as market performance has been behind that of emerging counterparts. The current capital gains tax rates are seen as a hindrance, leading to demands for a review.

articles.title: Trump set for midterm test: What's in store for India, Iran, Ukraine after November 4?
articles.desc: US midterm election 2026: American voters' sentiments about rising prices could affect Trump's standing in trade discussions. Congressional control will determine the scrutiny over Trump's actions regarding Iran and Ukraine. India will, however, continue navigating uncertainties in trade relations regardless of the election results.

articles.title: Anthropic plans to sell $3.5 billion of shares to Japan investors in IPO, filing shows
articles.desc: The new shares issued to Japanese investors will go to raise working capital and fund operating expenses and capital expenditure, the filing said.

articles.title: India, EU discuss FTA implementation ahead of December signing
articles.desc: In an effort to advance their free trade agreement, India and the European Union held pivotal discussions led by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal, who visited Brussels for dialogues with prominent EU officials. Central to the talks were customs cooperation and trade facilitation, deemed critical for the agreement's efficacy. Additionally, industry stakeholders from the diamond sector were engaged to harness opportunities within India's expanding market.

articles.title: India, EU discuss FTA implementation, customs cooperation and market access in Brussels
articles.desc: India and the European Union engaged in discussions regarding the implementation of their Free Trade Agreement. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal held meetings with various senior European Commission officials in Brussels, focusing on market access and customs procedures. The FTA is expected to eliminate tariffs on the majority of exports from both regions. Both parties are working towards the proposed signing and full ratification of the agreement.

articles.title: AI Agents Break Web Ad Model | Lightspeed’s Harsha, Hemant Mohapatra | Corner Office Conversation
HSBC to open Hong Kong AI Institute following Singapore launch
articles.desc: The AI unit will work with Hong Kong University of Science and Technology as its anchor academic partner, Elhedery said, though he did not disclose headcount details.

articles.title: India factory growth slows in October, export orders jump, PMI shows
articles.desc: India's manufacturing growth slowed in October, with the HSBC Manufacturing PMI falling to 54.7 from 55.1 in September, as domestic demand and hiring weakened. However, export orders rose at their fastest pace in six months, providing some support to factory activity.

articles.title: Apple's new CEO John Ternus to face first earnings test as memory costs surge
articles.desc: Ternus, who took the reins from Tim Cook in September, has overseen the introduction of Apple's first foldable phone, smart home hub and Apple's first touch-screen laptops. All of those products began shipping during the company's current fiscal first quarter, amid what Cook had called a "100-year flood" of rising memory costs.

articles.title: Tesla, Samsung oppose new US tariffs on Vietnam as probe deadline nears
articles.desc: Businesses are divided over whether Washington should propose new tariffs on Vietnamese goods this month, with Tesla and Samsung not in favour, while others have called for penalties, submissions to the US government show.

articles.title: China’s 5,000-ton digging machines are a trade war risk to India
articles.desc: China is tightening export controls on tunnel-boring machines and other specialised construction equipment, raising concerns that the restrictions could disrupt India's infrastructure projects, particularly along the disputed Himalayan border.

articles.title: AI debt surge pushes Magnificent Seven borrowing to $578 billion, up 45%: SBI Research
articles.desc: The combined debt of the seven largest US technology companies, widely known as the Magnificent Seven, has increased nearly 45 per cent to USD 578 billion by mid-2026, raising concerns over the financial risks linked to the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence infrastructure, according to a report by SBI Research.

articles.title: China's robot makers have mastered the moves. Now comes the race for brains
articles.desc: The shift is fuelling an investment boom in embodied AI, a field focused on software that allows robots to understand their surroundings, learn unfamiliar tasks and adapt without having to be programmed for every job.

articles.title: South Korea's Lee vows to make bold AI investment in record budget push
articles.desc: His administration proposed in September increasing government spending by a record 12.8% next year to 820.9 trillion won ($615.62 billion) aiming to strengthen South Korea's technological edge as global competition over AI intensifies.

articles.title: Binance sees outflows stabilising as exchange returns online after $6.3 billion heist
articles.desc: Binance customers pulled $3.64 billion, or 2.1% of its assets, as the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange resumed service after a security breach linked to North Korea saw $6.3 billion stolen from the platform last week.

articles.title: India likely to meet FY27 fiscal deficit target despite spending pressures: Goldman Sachs
articles.desc: The Centre appears on track to meet the fiscal deficit target set for FY27. Strong corporate tax collections are offsetting some revenue pressures observed in the first half of the fiscal year. The government's fiscal position improved significantly in September compared to August, aided by higher direct tax revenues. Focused expenditure reallocation will be crucial in achieving the deficit goals.
